commitResults.messageTitle: Renamed to Anaconda and added greeting

commitResults.messageBody: Parse complete user input into ToDo, Deadline, and Event objects while preserving date and time text. Split the task hierarchy into separate source files to satisfy A-Classes and A-Inheritance, and add the project-local visual review and UI testing workflows required for repeatable validation.

commitResults.messageTitle: Handle invalid commands with Anaconda exceptions
commitResults.messageBody: Validate empty descriptions, malformed date fields, unknown commands, and invalid task indexes without terminating the chatbot or corrupting its task list. Add an Anaconda-specific checked exception and expand the UI plan with interleaved positive and negative recovery cases.

Replace the fixed task array with an ArrayList so tasks can be added and removed dynamically. Add the delete command with task-count feedback and expand the console UI plan to verify deletion, renumbering, and invalid indexes.
